# Grep platform

The entrypoint keeps the research name for existing Cowork installs. Scripts are in this skill's scripts/ directory. Set SCRIPTS_DIR to that absolute path. Read [platform contract](resources/platform.md) on first use. Read only the relevant workflow below; when a workflow references another skill, use its reference from this list. No background surveillance or automatic paid batches are installed.
